name: hangar-invoices
description: Every invoice on the Hangar Supply vendor portal, as JSON.
prompt:
The browser is already signed in to the Hangar Supply vendor portal through its profile. Do not sign in or sign up.

1. Open {{portal_url}}/invoices.
2. The Invoices page has one table with the columns Invoice #, Invoice Date, Due Date, Description, Amount and Status. Read every row of that table.
3. Return invoices_json: a JSON array with one object per row, newest first, each with:
   - number: the Invoice # exactly as shown, for example HS-10480
   - issued: the Invoice Date, which the page shows as MM/DD/YYYY, written as YYYY-MM-DD
   - due: the Due Date, written as YYYY-MM-DD
   - description: the Description text
   - amount: the Amount without the $ sign or commas, with two decimals, for example 4215.50
   - currency: "USD"
   - status: the Status in lower case: paid, open or overdue

If the page shows a sign-in form instead of invoices, stop and fail with the message "signed out".

input_schema.name: portal_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the Hangar Supply portal, with no trailing slash

output_schema.name: invoices_json
output_schema.description: JSON array of invoices: number, issued (YYYY-MM-DD), due (YYYY-MM-DD), description, amount (like 1234.50), currency, status (paid | open | overdue)
